# Fahim Hossain - Shopify Developer Portfolio

## About

Fahim Hossain is a professional Shopify Developer and Front-End Developer specializing in custom Shopify solutions, Liquid customization, JavaScript, theme development, and high-performance eCommerce websites. Based in Bangladesh, available for remote work worldwide.

## Primary Expertise

- **Shopify Development**: Custom theme development, Liquid customization, Shopify Markets, app integrations, performance optimization
- **eCommerce Solutions**: High-converting stores, checkout optimization, product page customization
- **Front-End Development**: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, responsive design
- **Full-Stack Development**: MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js)

## Technical Skills

### Frontend
- React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript
- Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Material UI
- Framer Motion, GSAP, Swiper.js
- Redux, Axios

### Backend & Database
- Node.js, Express.js
- MongoDB, Firebase

### CMS & eCommerce
- Shopify (Liquid, Theme Development, Shopify Plus)
- Webflow, WordPress

### Tools & Others
- Git & GitHub
- Technical SEO
- Google Analytics 4
- Google Tag Manager
- Photoshop

## Services Offered

1. **Shopify Store Development** - Custom sections, Liquid customization, app integrations, performance optimization
2. **Custom Website Development** - Modern websites using Next.js, React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
3. **Webflow Development** - Pixel-perfect Webflow websites with CMS and SEO optimization
4. **MERN Stack Development** - Full-stack applications with MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js
5. **Technical SEO & Analytics** - Google Analytics 4, GTM, Meta Pixel, conversion tracking
6. **Website Maintenance** - Bug fixes, speed optimization, responsive improvements, content updates

## Portfolio Projects

- **Message Therapy** - Full custom Shopify design with Liquid and schema control
- **Car Detailer** - Unique design with full CSS control and responsiveness
- **Ovia Hair** - Custom design with complex layout and Shopify schema
- **Kajou Design** - Full-scale eCommerce solution for architecture and furniture
